questions.question_english: A Principal discovers that the school clerk has been forging vouchers and embezzling institutional funds. What is the mandatory immediate action the Principal must take under financial rules?

Quietly adjust the missing embezzled funds from the upcoming financial year’s general school budget allocation
Ask the clerk to return the missing money in small monthly installments without official reporting to protect reputation

questions.explanation_english: Report defalcation immediately to authorities and police, and start proceedings. Quietly adjusting missing funds, allowing installment repayments, or transferring the employee without formal reporting constitutes illegal concealment of financial crime

questions.explanation_english: Forecast of receipts and expenditures for the upcoming financial year. In government budgeting, “Budget Estimates” (BE) refers to the initial, formal forecast of anticipated receipts and proposed expenditures prepared for the upcoming financial year.
